label: a snapshot that never completed no longer blocks the shutdown
a failed simulator query is reported as an empty one
old: out="$(bounded_run 20 xcrun simctl list devices booted -j 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
new: out="$(bounded_run 20 xcrun simctl list devices booted -j 2>/dev/null)" || return 0

label: a dead lane's leftover lock still counts as a live lane
old: if [ -n "$lp" ] && kill -0 "$lp" 2>/dev/null; then echo "${lk##*/}"; return 0; fi

cleanup ignores a second live lane and shuts its simulators down
the shell gate job stops running the orphan-reap suite
a successful lane keeps its simulators and the sims-before snapshot
